column1: # The Full originals this directory's extractions were taken from, and their
# SHA-256 at the revision they were taken at.
# provenance.tsv says WHERE each extraction came from; this says WHAT it came
# from. Without it the record is a path, and an original that changed under a
# still-passing extraction would be noticed whenever somebody next looked. The
# lane checks both directions: every original named here is digested, and every
# original named in provenance.tsv is named here.
# When an original is deliberately changed, re-run the extraction's own lane,
# confirm the adaptation still agrees, and record the new digest here in the
# same commit. A digest updated on its own is the check being switched off.
